description: This file contains unit tests for the AWS SQS streaming provider within an Orleans-based distributed system. It sets up test clusters, configures SQS streams, and runs various streaming scenarios to verify producer/consumer interactions.

classes.name: SQSStreamTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of the SQS streaming provider with various producer and consumer configurations in an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with SQS streams and DynamoDB storage.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test runner before tests run.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deletes queues after tests complete.

methods.name: StreamTest_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a single producer grain with a single consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a single producer grain with a client as consumer.

methods.name: StreamTest_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a client as producer with a grain as consumer.

methods.name: StreamTest_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a client as producer with another client as consumer.

methods.name: StreamTest_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple producer grains with multiple consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests multiple producer grains with multiple consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple producer clients with multiple consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests multiple producer clients with multiple consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many producer grains with many consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains
methods.description: Tests many consumer grains with many producer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many producer grains with many consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many producer clients with many consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater
methods.description: Tests a scenario where the same grain acts as consumer first, then producer.

methods.name: StreamTest_14_SameGrain_ProducerFirstConsumerLater
methods.description: Tests a scenario where the same grain acts as producer first, then consumer.

methods.name: StreamTest_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Tests consumption triggered at producer's request.

methods.name: StreamTest_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple streams with many producer and consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple streams with many producer and consumer grains, with additional silo start.
